# Backend Contracts Checklist: Execution Backend Contracts

**Purpose**: Reviewer gate for completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the owned
backend-family, catalog, execution, routing, usage, and compatibility requirements
**Created**: 2026-09-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an
item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the semantic differences and non-substitutability rules for model API, coding harness, local runtime, and test-only fixture profiles fully defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK002 Are all identities that must remain separate enumerated consistently across catalog, execution, routing, checkpoint, and conformance requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK003 Are discovery, probe, health, authentication, capability, model relation, and conformance evidence requirements present for every eligibility input? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-008, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK004 Are start, cancel, resume, event, result, failure, usage, and checkpoint semantics specified for both success and non-success outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-017, US2]
- [x] CHK005 Are compatibility and evolution requirements defined for common contracts, family profiles, capability profiles, model descriptor versions, and checkpoints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, §FR-030, US4-AS4]
- [x] CHK006 Are legacy Feature 001 record and behavior requirements explicit enough to distinguish regression compatibility from new Feature 002 writes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034, SC-010, Plan §Data]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is “qualified” defined as a derived, expiring state with an exhaustive mandatory evidence set rather than a mutable adapter claim? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005–FR-008, §FR-029]
- [x] CHK008 Are required, optional, unsupported, temporarily unavailable, unknown, and not-applicable capability meanings mutually exclusive and scoped? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §CapabilityDescriptor]
- [x] CHK009 Are liveness, readiness, degradation, freshness, and authentication posture defined distinctly enough to prevent contradictory eligibility interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, US1]
- [x] CHK010 Are event ordering, duplicate, gap, terminal, post-terminal, replay, and reconciliation meanings unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Are normalized failure categories and retry/reconciliation dispositions sufficiently defined to avoid mapping one failure to conflicting actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013–FR-014]
- [x] CHK012 Are usage quantity, unit, scope, source, confidence, measurement kind, quota, and monetary-cost meanings explicitly separated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, SC-009]
- [x] CHK013 Is “compatible additive version” bounded by objective semantic and evidence criteria rather than version labels alone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, US4-AS4, Contracts README §Compatibility]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Do provider-neutrality requirements align with the bounded extension mechanism without permitting provider-private fields through an alternate path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016–FR-017, Contracts README §Contract rules]
- [x] CHK015 Do model immutability requirements align with connection-specific discovery and availability updates without implying descriptor mutation or duplication? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, US1-AS2, Data Model §ModelDescriptor]
- [x] CHK016 Do route determinism requirements align with start-time revalidation and successor decisions without allowing historical decision mutation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019–FR-021, US3]
- [x] CHK017 Do cancellation terminal semantics align with unknown external effects, reconciliation, and exactly-one terminal backend result? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012–FR-014, US2-AS3]
- [x] CHK018 Do checkpoint portability requirements preserve family/profile constraints rather than contradicting the prohibition on silent capability downgrade? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-020, §FR-022–FR-024]
- [x] CHK019 Does the test-only fixture profile remain consistently excluded from real support claims in the spec, plan, data model, and contract notes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033–FR-035, Plan §Contract layers]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK020 Can qualification eligibility and exclusion reasons be objectively derived for every fixture state named by SC-001? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK021 Is “equivalent observable meaning” bounded by exact fields or comparison rules while preserving distinct provenance? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, US2 Independent Test]
- [x] CHK022 Can zero prohibited-field leakage be evaluated across all authoritative and public destinations named in the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK023 Is byte-equivalent deterministic routing scoped to a normalized snapshot and evaluator version so observational timestamps cannot create false failures? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK024 Are the valid and invalid checkpoint populations complete enough to measure SC-006 without undefined compatibility cases? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Edge Cases]

## Scenario and Edge Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are zero-model, duplicate-model, cross-family connection, contradictory claim, stale probe, and late-result requirements all addressed rather than only listed as examples? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-003–FR-008]
- [x] CHK026 Are no-candidate, all-degraded, budget-exhausted, identical tie-break, and state-change-before-start routing scenarios covered by normative outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-018–FR-021]
- [x] CHK027 Are usage decrease, overflow, unit change, unknown confidence, and mixed synthetic/measured edge requirements resolved by fail-closed or preservation semantics? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK028 Are partial discovery, probe timeout, cancellation race, multiple terminal result, and post-terminal event requirements specified as exception flows? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, US2]
- [x] CHK029 Are exclusions for real adapters, credentials, provider optimization, broad UI, and production operations consistent with every contract-facing requirement? [Scope, Spec §Exclusions, §FR-033–FR-036]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK030 Are dependency assumptions on Feature 001 contracts, persistence, runner, evidence, and recovery explicitly versioned or linked so implementation cannot rely on chat context? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Data]
- [x] CHK031 Are OD-007, OD-009, and OD-010 correctly identified as later gates without becoming unresolved blockers for deterministic fixture contracts? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §Exclusions]
- [x] CHK032 Are the 100-candidate and 500-case scale boundaries clearly identified as slice validation envelopes rather than production support claims? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and
  `$speckit-clarify`.
